subject: Deal structure + compliance gate for volume pricing
messages:
From: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@bluepine.io>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jason Li <jason.li@bluepine.io>
Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Inquiry: volume pricing + compliance gating

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the demo last week — BluePine is excited about Redwood's latency profile for our streaming enrichment pipeline. Before we get into committed numbers, procurement has two gating conditions they won't waive: a signed DPA and a current SOC 2 Type II attestation.

High-level ask: can Redwood provide a SOC2 summary and a DPA draft we can route to legal? BluePine is evaluating a 12-month usage commitment with per-token tiers, but we need the compliance artifacts before we finalize the tiered rates.

Also, quick question on packaging: do you support a blended per-token rate with a small monthly reservation credit, or is it strictly pure per-token tiers? Jason from procurement is cc'd — he'll handle contract flow.

Appreciate a quick reply,
Samantha
Samantha Ortiz
Head of Data Platforms | BluePine Analytics

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@bluepine.io>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Jason Li <jason.li@bluepine.io>
Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Inquiry: volume pricing + compliance gating

Samantha — great to hear. We can absolutely share SOC 2 summary and a DPA draft. Attaching the summary and the current DPA template for your review.

On packaging: we support both pure per-token committed tiers and hybrid structures (monthly reservation credit + per-token). For a first pass, we typically propose:
- Tier A: 0-500M tokens / month -> $0.0022 per token
- Tier B: 500M-1B tokens / month -> $0.0018 per token
- Hybrid option: $20k/month reservation credit + lowered per-token floor by ~12% depending on volume profile

If procurement requires compliance gating prior to final pricing, we can mark any quoted committed tier as contingent on signed DPA + SOC2 attestation. I'll loop in legal and rev ops to confirm the gate mechanics and the timeline.

Next steps: I'll ask Karthik to coordinate the final deal structure and get Laura to share the DPA/attestation.

Best,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Inquiry: volume pricing + compliance gating

Team — forwarding BluePine's ask. Short bullets on what we need to sign off internally: 
- Sales: confirm target committed volumes and recommended packaging (Marissa's ranges ok?).
- Legal: provide DPA and confirm if we require SOC2 Type II attestation or summary is sufficient for gating. If attestation required, what's the fastest way to get a redacted attestation to the customer?
- RevOps: confirm how to mark pricing as "compliance-gated" in the quote so it's not applied until DPA signed.
- SE: any technical notes we should include about data handling and region controls for their GCP tenancy.

Goal: provide BluePine with a one-page "mutual action plan" showing milestones (DPA sent, DPA signed, SOC2 attestation provided, PO issued, pricing effective). Can someone own drafting the MAP?

Thanks — I'll prepare the HubSpot record and coordinate DocuSign steps once legal confirms the DPA.
- Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Sales, Enterprise

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 12:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Inquiry: volume pricing + compliance gating

Karthik / Marissa — attaching the current DPA (Redwood_DPA_2026_v3.docx) and a two-page SOC 2 Type II summary (Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_Summary.pdf).

Notes: 
- We can provide the SOC2 Type II report under NDA if BluePine needs the full attestation; otherwise the summary and control matrix should satisfy most procurement gates.
- DPA is standard; exceptions to liability caps require executive approval and will elongate the timeline.
- We can mark pricing as contingent: discount effective date = date DPA countersigned. RevOps: set effective_date gating on doc-signature.

I'll prepare a redlined DPA if BluePine returns comments.
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

From: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@bluepine.io>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jason Li <jason.li@bluepine.io>, procurement@bluepine.io
Date: Thu, 17 Sep 2026 10:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Inquiry: volume pricing + compliance gating

Marissa / team — thank you for the quick turnaround and the attachments. Procurement reviewed the SOC2 summary; they want the full attestation under NDA before they will sign any committed pricing. Global procurement policy requires attestation + signed DPA prior to price lock.

Can you:
1) Share the full SOC2 Type II report (redacted as needed) under an NDA?
2) Provide a DocuSign-ready DPA so we can accelerate routing to legal and procurement?

If Redwood can commit to that flow, BluePine is ready to move to a 12-month agreed volume band and issue a PO within two weeks of receipt/verification. Also please confirm the exact date the discounted tier would become effective (we need that on the PO).

Regards,
Samantha

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@bluepine.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Inquiry: volume pricing + compliance gating

Samantha — thanks, and totally understood on procurement policy. Quick summary of next steps from our side: 
- Legal (Laura) will provision the full SOC2 Type II report under Redwood's mutual NDA. Laura — Laura to confirm target delivery by EOD Monday with redactions as appropriate.
- I'll prepare a DocuSign DPA package (Laura will review one last time) and share the link to BluePine's procurement group. Effective date for discounted tier will be the countersignature date on the DPA (we will mirror that in the DocuSign envelope).
- Hannah — can you confirm RevOps will tag the quote as "compliance-gated" and ensure billing only applies the discount from the effective_date field?

Samantha — once DPA is countersigned and attestation verified, we'll mark the HubSpot deal as "pricing-effective" and issue an updated quote. HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/DEAL-BP-0421

If that works for BluePine, Marissa and I can coordinate a short mutual action plan to keep things on a two-week timetable.

Best,
Karthik
